bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26300.7733 Released - **Microsoft** introduces Sysmon functionality natively for enhanced threat detection.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26220.7752 Available - New features and fixes rolled out in the **Beta Channel** for **Windows 11**.
Evolving Security Practices for AI - **Microsoft's** Secure Development Lifecycle adapts to address AI-specific security challenges.
PostgreSQL on Azure Enhanced for AI - **Azure** optimizes **PostgreSQL** to support AI-driven applications and developer experiences.
Infostealers Targeting macOS - **Microsoft Defender** reports a rise in infostealer threats exploiting macOS and Python.
Securing AI Application Supply Chains - **Microsoft** emphasizes the importance of securing AI frameworks against vulnerabilities.
AI-Driven Detection Insights - **Microsoft** introduces AI-assisted workflows to enhance threat detection and analysis.
Data Security Index Report Released - **Microsoft** highlights the need for robust data security in the age of AI.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1495 Launched - New features and fixes introduced in the **Canary Channel**.
